story.titleZh: LAP 32/71 格尼襟翼，乔治完成10秒处罚，重返第8位
story.summaryZh: 乔治在LAP 32/71时被要求进站更换中胎，并完成了10秒的处罚。他重返赛道后位于第8位，一旦林德布拉德和科拉平托停止，他的净排名将是第6位。

story.summaryEn:
LAP 32/71
📻 “Box, box” comes the call to George as he heads in for a set of Mediums and serves his 10 second penalty.
He rejoins in P8, which will be a net P6 once Lindblad and Colapinto stop.
detailZh:
第32圈/第71圈
📻 “维修区，维修区”的呼叫传来，乔治正要进入维修区进行一组中低速轮胎更换，并服刑10秒。
他回到第8位发车，一旦林德布拉德和科拉平托停止，这将净增第6位发车。

relatedItems.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队对巴西站的自由练习表示满意，车手在单圈跑中感觉良好，尽管条件复杂。

relatedItems.originalTitle: 💬 It was a positive day overall and I felt good in the car, particularly on the single lap runs. The conditions were quite tricky with the low grip...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
💬 It was a positive day overall and I felt good in the car, particularly on the single lap runs. The conditions were quite tricky with the low grip, and it wasn’t easy to find the right balance, but I think we made some good progress between FP1 and FP2. 
Hear what Kimi, George and Shov have to say about Friday in Brasil 👉 https://bit.ly/BrasilFriReportX
detailZh:
💬 总体来说，今天是个积极的一天，我在车内感觉很好，尤其是在单圈跑道上。天气条件相当棘手，抓地力低，找到正确的平衡并不容易，但我想我们在FP1和FP2之间取得了一些进步。
听听基米、乔治和肖夫对周五在巴西的看法👉 https://bit.ly/BrasilFriReportX
detailEn:
💬 It was a positive day overall and I felt good in the car, particularly on the single lap runs. The conditions were quite tricky with the low grip, and it wasn’t easy to find the right balance, but I think we made some good progress between FP1 and FP2. 
Hear what Kimi, George and Shov have to say about Friday in Brasil 👉 https://bit.ly/BrasilFriReportX
